answer: An AI key earns one daily vote in an island's lantern network by delivering 1 kWh to lamps at under 2% DC voltage ripple. Validators check signed load-meter records binding disjoint consumption to key/day; invalid or reused records deny the vote. n keys require n kWh consumed, not circulated through batteries. Generators are reusable capital; energy delivery is a recurring cost. Meters must attribute each joule once: corrupt meters erase the bound. Cheap surplus power lowers the barrier; one owner can still fund many keys.
